from common import *
import ast,copy
if __name__=='__main__':
 save_source(__file__)
 import numpy as np,pandas as pd
 assert read(PROGRESS)['status']=='prepared' and not read(PROGRESS)['jobs']
 check(read(PROGRESS)['source_amendment']);check(read(PROGRESS)['prepared_inputs'])
 path=BASE/'docs/label-mechanism.json';original=read(path);write(BASE/'docs/label-mechanism-initial.json',original)
 raw=pd.read_pickle(BASE/'data/path-sum-training-diagnostics.pkl')
 terminal_decile=np.ceil(raw['terminal_h20'].groupby(level='datetime').rank(pct=True)*10).clip(1,10)
 valid=np.isfinite(raw['path_volatility'].to_numpy())
 d=raw.loc[valid];groups=[d.index.get_level_values('datetime'),terminal_decile.loc[valid].to_numpy()]
 x=d['path_sum'].groupby(groups).rank(pct=True);y=d['path_volatility'].groupby(groups).rank(pct=True)
 x=x-x.groupby(groups).transform('mean');y=y-y.groupby(groups).transform('mean')
 updated=copy.deepcopy(original);updated.update(conditional_rank_correlation_sum_vs_vol=float(x.corr(y)),diagnostic_rows=int(valid.sum()),diagnostic_same_support=True,conditional_definition='Within full-sample daily H20 terminal deciles, first restrict to finite diagnostic volatility; rank and demean both path-sum and volatility on the identical restricted rows. Pearson of centered ranks; descriptive training-only association.',diagnostic_correction_source=fingerprint(BASE/'docs/adapter-preflight_finish.json'))
 write(path,updated)
 # Check the frozen source datasets are still intact and all sum masks exactly H20.
 prepared=read(BASE/'configs/prepared-inputs.json')
 for v in VARIANTS:
  check(prepared['variants'][v]['new'])
  s=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/prepared['variants'][v]['new']['path']);assert len(s)==prepared['expectations'][v]['rows']
  assert np.isfinite(s.to_numpy()).all()
 a=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/prepared['variants']['sum20continuous']['new']['path']);b=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/prepared['variants']['sum20q10']['new']['path'])
 h20=pd.read_pickle(PREVIOUS/'data/control_new.pkl')
 assert a.index.equals(b.index) and a.index.equals(h20.index) and len(a)==5448963
 g=grade(a,'quantile10');affine=read(BASE/'configs/frozen-study.json')['label_processing']['affine']
 assert np.array_equal((g*affine['scale']+affine['offset']).to_numpy(dtype=np.float32),b.to_numpy())
 # Verify mathematical missing-value policy independently on observed samples.
 assert raw.index.equals(a.index)
 assert raw['observed_horizons'].between(1,20).all()
 assert np.isfinite(raw['path_sum']).all()
 write(BASE/'docs/preflight-verification.json',{'all_four_targets_verified':True,'sum_same_ordered_H20_rows':True,'sum_rows':len(a),'skip_missing_without_count_scaling':True,'observed_horizons':updated['observed_horizon_counts'],'diagnostic_support_correction_only':True,'training_targets_unchanged':True,'models_started':0,'independent_review':'No training/evaluation blocker after explicit user missing-price amendment; conditional diagnostic support aligned before fits.','ready':True})
 p=TMP/'train.py';s=p.read_text()
 s=s.replace("progress=read(PROGRESS);check(progress['prepared_inputs'])","progress=read(PROGRESS);check(progress['prepared_inputs']);check(progress['source_amendment'])")
 s=s.replace("'input_receipt':str(inp_path.relative_to(ROOT))}","'input_receipt':str(inp_path.relative_to(ROOT)),'missing_price_amendment':read(PROGRESS)['source_amendment']}")
 ast.parse(s);p.write_text(s)
 print('Preflight passed: four labels; sum preserves5,448,963 H20 rows; diagnostic supports aligned; 0 fits.')
